scope: Exact provenance/hash audit for the 58-check native GUI test inputs; this JSON contains metadata only, not the private seed image, Windows tree, R4 ZIP, or test media payloads.

R4_source_archive.pinned_by: the original R4 source-input manifest and private preparation recipe

Windows_fixture.identity: read-only stock Windows fixture recorded in private preparation metadata; absolute source location omitted

PREPFIX.PY.source_identity: private first-party fixture preparation script; source retained in local review evidence
PREPFIX.PY.role: constructs the temporary fixture image and copies pinned test members from the verified R4 archive; its source comment labels extracted data as original bounded test fixtures, not songs or sampled media.

R4 source input manifest.role: records seed-image and original R4 runtime input pins.

prepared fixture input record.status: prepared but not executed by its own preparation script; its base-image hash matches the saved native run result.

MAKEQA.PY.role: contains deterministic first-party byte literals for the three bundled QA files; literals hash-match R4 archive and package RUNTIME files.

MAKEGUIQA.PY.role: first-party deterministic hex generator for the five additional synthetic GUI-QA fixtures; requires an existing empty output directory and checks every embedded SHA-256 before writing.
